chapter: Big Eye Louis and Barnes's own playing
title: Reeds: cutting stiff cane reeds and switching to a plastic reed
summary: Barnes describes how an older clarinetist cut his reeds extra stiff, where he buys reeds, and his difficult change to a long-lasting plastic reed.
